# anthropic_users (Data Source)

Lists members of the organization through the Admin API, most recently added first, with optional filters. Needs `read:members` on a Claude Enterprise key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_users" "owners" {
  roles = ["owner", "primary_owner"]
}

output "owner_emails" {
  value = [for user in data.anthropic_users.owners.users : user.email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Filter by member email. The API matches case-insensitively and tolerates common variants of the same address, such as a `+tag` suffix.
- `roles` (Set of String) Filter to members holding any of these roles. A Claude Console organization accepts `user`, `developer`, `billing`, `admin` and `claude_code_user`, and a Claude Enterprise organization accepts `user`, `owner`, `primary_owner`, `membership_admin` and `managed`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the configured filters.
- `users` (Attributes List) The matching members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the member joined the organization.
- `email` (String) Email of the member.
- `id` (String) ID of the member.
- `name` (String) Name of the member.
- `role` (String) Organization role of the member.
